request: Treat surrounding double quotes in a .gitconfig core.excludesFile value as part of the path, so our configuration validator can flag quoted paths as invalid.

source.request: Treat surrounding double quotes in a .gitconfig core.excludesFile value as part of the path, so our configuration validator can flag quoted paths as invalid.
source.settled: The global exclusion configuration parser accepts paths surrounded by double quotes.
source.why: Keeping the quotes as filename characters prevents valid quoted exclusion paths from being loaded.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
